name: Backend API Layer
description: DRF ViewSets, serializers, and URL routers across all Django apps that together expose the 71-endpoint REST surface consumed by the web and mobile clients.

name: Backend Data Layer
description: Django ORM models, database migrations, and the custom UserManager that define the PostGIS-backed schema for users, labs, appointments, analyses, inventory, and notifications.

name: Backend Service Layer
description: Cross-cutting Django infrastructure providing permission classes, OTP and Firebase auth services, TOTP 2FA, JWT token generation, notification event dispatch, PDF report generation, Celery task configuration, Django app configs, admin registrations, management commands, and shared middleware utilities.

name: Web UI Layer
description: React 19 + Vite web dashboard presenting the staff-facing interface with role-aware screens for dashboard, analyses, inventory, nurses map, staff management, statistics, and settings, built on shared components, hooks, and a centralized API and auth context.

name: Mobile UI Layer
description: React Native (Expo 54) mobile application for patients and nurses, covering lab discovery with map search, appointment booking with CNAM support, test result viewing, PDF download, biometric authentication, nurse home-visit workflow, and real-time notification polling.

name: Infrastructure Layer
description: Container and deployment definitions for the labConnect platform, including the Django backend Dockerfile, Docker Compose database service, Render.com deployment blueprints, and the Docker build-context exclusion list.

name: Documentation and Configuration
description: Project-level API reference, developer setup guides, Python dependency manifest, and tooling configuration files that support development workflow without being part of any runnable application layer.
